notes.title: [OWH Ver 2.09→2.10 OWH+ Ver 1.47→1.48 Changes]
notes.content:
Dear fans,

Thank you for playing One Way Heroics.
We have a new update for the game today.

It might not look that different, but there have been several big internal changes including an upgrade to the game engine, so if you encounter any problems or notice anything strange during gameplay, please contact us here on the Steam forums:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/266210/discussions/0/3810659494971526626/

[h1]Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*][OWH/OWH+] The game engine has been updated.
- Overall processing speed and startup time has been improved
- In-game text will now be rendered in Unicode (UTF-8)
- However, characters that are incompatible with the font will still not display properly
- The game now behaves differently on the character naming screen. Now, you can continue typing even if you exceed the character limit, but when you press Enter to confirm, the text will be cut off at the character limit.
- Save files created after this update will have a different format than previous saves. This will not cause any problems as long as you're playing the newest version on Steam, but if you're playing on a different platform, your older saves may not load properly when they're copied over.
- The system requirements for the game have changed. Windows 2000, XP, and Vista have been removed, and Windows 11 has been added to the list of compatible systems.
[*][OWH/OWH+ English version only] The in-game text will now display in a similar but different font when your system locale is set to Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, or Korean. This was added because of an issue that caused the text to overflow off-screen in these locales.
[*][OWH/OWH+] We tried to fix the bug where the text log would sometimes fail to show up.
[*]You can now choose to forgo using the game launcher and instead launch the game in the Steam client from the Steam launch options.
[/list]
Thank you, and we hope you continue to enjoy the game!

notes.content:

Adding to the above updates, we got new information for anyone who cannot start the game.
This might not solve all the problems, but we will share with everyone just in case.

Problem: Game does not start!
When OWH/OWH+ is executed from Steam, it starts inside the Avast sandbox (antivirus program),
and it becomes the case where "Steam says the game is working, but the task manager won't show any game in the process list."
So, if you cannot find the working OWH/OWH+, please check the sandbox of your anti-virus software.
-----

-----------------
JP
-----------------
【片道勇者(OWH) Ver1.78→1.79
　片道勇者プラス(OWH+)　Ver1.11→1.12　の修正点】

●[OWH/OWH+]マップ上でメニューを開くと動いている途中の
　　　　　スクロールが止まってしまうバグを修正

●[OWH/OWH+]フルスクリーン時、16:9のディスプレイでも縦横比が4:3に自動調節されるよう修正。
　　　　 ただし全ての環境には対応しておりませんのでご了承ください。

●[OWH+のみ]残り回数2回以上の「書（Parchment）」をショートカットから使用すると
　　　　　　残り回数に関係なく消滅してしまうバグを修正

●[OWH+のみ]特徴（Perks）の解放画面にて、『必殺の達人（Masterful Stroke）』の表記が
　　　　必殺率（Critical Hit Chance）+10％になっていたが正しくは+7％だったので修正
-----------------

それと、「ゲームがスタートできない問題」の1つのケースについて
情報が寄せられました。
これが全ての解決になるわけではないと思いますが、
ひとまず以下に掲載しておきます。

-----------------

●ゲームが起動しない問題について

　SteamからOne Way Heroics (Plus)を実行したとき、
　Avastのサンドボックス内で実行されてしまい、
　「Steam上では起動中扱いになっているもののタスクマネージャのプロセスには
　　表示されない」というケースが報告されています。
　もし起動しても何も反応がないように見える場合は、
　アンチウィルスソフトのサンドボックス内をご確認ください。

--------

notes.title: 8/29/2014 Ver. 1.75 Update
notes.content:
The Version 1.75 update to One Way Heroics includes the following changes:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where if multiple spear attacks occurred, two additional attacks would follow each one.

[*]Increased the drop rate for Slender Spear by 1.5x. 

[*]Increased the chance that Slender Spear will appear in shops by 1.2x.

[*]The “My First Vault” and “My First Perk” achievements will now automatically be obtained upon starting the game if you meet the prerequisites. [*]Added a little more content to Fairy Iris’ guide.

[*]Added content to the Readme; now includes some of the FAQ.
[/list]

notes.title: OWH Update Live! Patch Notes Within!
notes.content:
